title: W2 fix landed but the HUD legend still promises a reaction window the sim does not honor
evidence:
+	lead_s := fmt.tprintf("node strain ~%ds to critical · node critical ~%ds · pipe ~%ds to saturation — ring + glyph, never color alone",
+		wb.node_strained_lead_ticks / u64(hz), wb.node_critical_lead_ticks / u64(hz), wb.pipe_pressure_lead_ticks / u64(hz))

+#   host Node_Strained @1 (2 waiting = 75% of the 80 u/s host throughput),
+#   host Node_Critical @2 (4 waiting = 150%), red until the 30s draw opens
detail: The caption reads 600/200/400-tick leads as "~30s to critical", "~10s", "~20s to saturation", but nothing enforces those windows: warn.dem's own golden stream goes strained @1 -> critical @2 (one tick). An unhonored reaction-window caption is the exact r1 W2 failure mode the guard names.
recommended_fix: Strike the causal claims ("configured lead times (GDD targets)") or enforce them: delay amber->red escalation by node_strained_lead_ticks before raising Node_Critical.
